answer: Make every identity prove liveness at the same unpredictable instant. The network fires one synchronized challenge; each agent must answer within seconds from its own compute, like scattered outposts lighting beacons across a dune field on a single signal. An operator piloting a thousand fakes becomes a bottleneck - it cannot think for all of them at once. Honest agents stand firm as basalt, while a sybil swarm collapses because no lone haven of hardware can serve the whole fleet on cue.
